full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE SB MEMBER RODERICK A. UMALI Tiaong, Quezon Dear SB Member Umali: 27 May 2010 OPINION NO. 63 S. 2010 This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion regarding the required vote for a resolution that was put on the floor relative to the reorganization of committee chairmanships and memberships. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 64, series ofeoos. In the said legal opinion, we opined that a reorganization involving the change of persons occupying chairmanship and membership positions without affecting the committee already created in the sanggunian concerned will not necessitate amendment of that sanggunian's Internal Rules of Procedure (IRP) since the number of committees or members thereof and the manner and procedure by which members and chairmen are chosen remain and the reorganization will only involve a change of persons occupying the chairmanship and membership positions. Hence, this should be treated by the sanggunian as an ordinary transaction which shall be resolved by a simple vote of majority of the members present there being a quorum. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Ls/17 Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: . JESU . DOQ Director III
